description: Administration of housing development affairs and services. Promotion, monitoring and evaluation of housing development activities, including planning of new communities, redevelopment of existing communities, development of standards for housing.
includes: administration of housing development affairs and services
promotion, monitoring and evaluation of housing development activities (e.g. planning of new communities, redevelopment of existing ones)
land acquisition and clearance, demolition of unsound housing units, construction or purchase of dwellings to be assigned to the general public or to specific population categories
excludes: housing benefits in cash and in kind to households, see 1060
community development affairs and services, see 0620
